about: Brighton is a municipality on Lake Ontario in Northumberland County, Ontario, covering the former town and surrounding countryside near Presqu’ile Provincial Park—not only a downtown strip. Apple country, a harbour, and a role as an east-of-Toronto lakeside stop define the community. About 12,000 people live in Brighton.
